name: Bubble Break ASMR Tabletop
request: Create a small, playable Bubble Break ASMR game for one player on desktop and touch. The player presses individual bubbles on a reusable bubble-wrap sheet. A press visibly depresses and pops that bubble with synchronized satisfying pop audio, then adds exactly one to the popped counter after the pop completes. Holding, spamming, or pressing a popped bubble must not count twice. Let the player finish a sheet of at least twelve bubbles, see completion feedback, and deliberately reset to a fresh sheet. Use a close, readable tabletop presentation and minimal counter/reset UI. Search Marketplace first for a complete reusable interaction, including any existing geometry, animation, sounds and behavior; inspect what it already provides and integrate only missing features. Search separately for missing media if needed. Audio must come from Marketplace and actually play. Record unavailable importer capabilities rather than pretending a suitable scripted component does not exist. Choose reasonable details yourself; no saving, multiplayer, purchases or large map. Success needs observed press/pop/recovery timing, per-bubble state, exact counting, sheet completion/reset and usable desktop/touch input. Do not claim success from code inspection alone.

spec.title: Bubble Break ASMR Tabletop
spec.summary: A relaxing and tactile single-player Bubble Break ASMR tabletop experience designed for both desktop (mouse click) and touch devices. Upon loading, the player is presented with a cozy, clean tabletop featuring a bubble-wrap sheet with 16 translucent bubbles arranged in a neat grid. The player can click or tap individual bubbles. When pressed, the bubble visibly squishes and pops with an ASMR pop sound effect, changing state to popped (deflated/translucent greyed out) and adding exactly 1 to the popped bubble counter once the pop sequence finishes. Repeated clicking, holding, or spamming a popped bubble does not trigger extra counts or pop effects. When all bubbles on the sheet are popped, satisfying completion feedback (visual banner and chime) appears. The player can click the deliberate 'Reset Sheet' button at any time to unpop all bubbles and reset the sheet for endless stress relief.
spec.visualDirection: Cozy, minimalist tabletop ASMR aesthetic. The central focus is an ivory wooden desk with soft warm lighting. In the center sits a realistic translucent bubble-wrap mat with glowing, soft-curved dome bubbles. Unpopped bubbles have a clean glossy plastic sheen with subtle subsurface glow; popped bubbles flatten, wrinkle slightly, and dim in specular gloss. UI is clean and unobtrusive: a modern top HUD displaying 'Popped: X / Total' and a soft-rounded 'New Sheet' button with tactile hover/press states. Visual pop effects include subtle ring particle ripples.
